title: Manual Setting of K-mer Coverage Peaks for Meta-Velvetg
author: Afiahayati
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d7k9kv

steps.title: Run initial Velvet assemblies
steps.instruction: Execute velveth, velvetg, and meta-velvetg as described in the Getting Started protocol, then verify that the file out-dir/meta-velvetg.Graph2-stats.txt has been created.

steps.title: Create k‑mer coverage histogram
steps.instruction: In R, install and load the plotrix package, read the stats file, and plot a weighted histogram of short‑read coverage using breaks from 0 to 200 in increments of 1.

steps.title: Determine coverage peak values
steps.instruction: Inspect the histogram and manually record the k‑mer coverage peaks; for example, peaks may be observed around 210×, 120×, 70×, 45×, 23×, 12×, and 6×.

steps.title: Run meta‑velvetg with peaks
steps.instruction: Run meta‑velvetg with the insert length set to 260 and the expected coverage peaks supplied in descending order, e.g.: meta-velvetg out-dir -ins_length 260 -exp_covs 214_122_70_43_25_13.5
